user.title: Creality printer
user.description: Enter the LAN IP of your Creality printer (WebSocket port 9999).

data_description.timelapse_folder: Optional. Where timelapse videos are saved, automatically or with the card's Save timelapse button. Add a NAS share under Settings → System → Storage (usage "Media") and use /media/ followed by the share name. Can also be changed from the Creality card.
data_description.timelapse_auto_save: Copy the video into the folder when a print finishes or is stopped. Needs a folder.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer WebSocket on port 9999.
error.folder_not_absolute: Enter an absolute path, for example /media/nas/timelapses.
error.folder_not_allowed: Home Assistant may not write to this folder. Use a folder under /media (network storage added with usage "Media" appears there) or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.folder_not_writable: The folder could not be created or is not writable. Check that the share is mounted and writable.

error.custom_url_required: Enter a camera URL when camera mode is set to custom.
error.invalid_camera_url: The camera URL must start with http:// or https:// (MJPEG stream or snapshot).
error.folder_not_absolute: Enter an absolute path, for example /media/nas/timelapses.
error.folder_not_allowed: Home Assistant may not write to this folder. Use a folder under /media (network storage added with usage "Media" appears there) or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.folder_not_writable: The folder could not be created or is not writable. Check that the share is mounted and writable.

data_description.timelapse_folder: Optional. Where timelapse videos are saved, automatically or with the card's Save timelapse button. Add a NAS share under Settings → System → Storage (usage "Media") and use /media/ followed by the share name. Can also be changed from the Creality card.
data_description.timelapse_auto_save: Copy the video into the folder when a print finishes or is stopped. Needs a folder.
